fields.description:
Discovered during the Step 7 sibling sweep of 35ab-f0e0-3e4a-4b72 (fightable-nirvanic-kitten).

## Site
`ExpressionError(WorkflowError)` is defined at `src/rebar/llm/workflow/executor.py:251` and raised from workflow execute-time expression resolution (`interpreter.py` and `executor.py`) for wiring/state faults: input not set, no such step output, loop/map var out of scope, missing secret/env, or unresolvable `${{ }}` expression.

## Symptom
`error_code_for(ExpressionError(...))` currently reaches the broad `LLMError`/`WorkflowError` branch and returns `llm_unavailable`. That asserts a provider outage for a caller/state wiring fault and encourages retries that will not self-heal.

## Operator decision
Latest DECISION NEEDED comment (operator-approved 2026-09-01) supersedes the earlier `expression_unresolved` option for this ticket: reclassify `ExpressionError -> invalid_input`, matching prior bug 35ab (executor unknown-step -> invalid_input) and dbca (parse/lint -> invalid_input). Give `ExpressionError` an explicit `error_code = "invalid_input"` so the mapping is honest regardless of branch order. Preserve dbca AC3 by ensuring genuine execute-time LLM outages still map to `llm_unavailable` through the true outage type/wrapper path. Implement this with ce6b's umbrella narrowing as one coherent change.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `ExpressionError` has an explicit `error_code = "invalid_input"` and `error_code_for(ExpressionError(...))` returns `invalid_input`, verified by a focused unit/contract test.
- [x] A real workflow execute-surface expression-resolution failure returns `invalid_input`, not `llm_unavailable`, verified through the real workflow execution surface or the smallest existing production error conversion seam that exercises the same exception.
- [x] A genuine LLM outage inside an execute step still returns `llm_unavailable`, verified by a focused test covering the preserved dbca AC3 path.
- [x] The implementation lands in the same Gerrit change as ce6b and references both tickets.

## Testing
Run the focused workflow/error taxonomy tests added or updated for this ticket with `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest -q`, then run `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint` and `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make typecheck`. After commit, run `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" rebar verify-commit-ticket HEAD` to verify ticket trailers.

File-impact update after implementation: this ticket is closed by the combined Gerrit #2482 commit with ce6b, so its recorded impact includes the shared taxonomy files and held-out compatibility tests touched by that single coherent change, not only `ExpressionError` itself.
